address.description: The EVM wallet address (checksummed or lowercase, 0x-prefixed)

chainId.description: The EVM chain ID where the signature was created

message.description: The EIP-712 typed data message that was signed

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attestation was created

signature.description: The EIP-712 signature in hex format (0x-prefixed, 65 bytes for ECDSA, longer for smart contract sigs)

signatureType.description: The type of signature: eoa (EOA/ECDSA), erc1271 (smart contract), erc6492 (counterfactual)

main.description: An attestation linking an ATProto DID to an EVM wallet address, signed with EIP-712.

nonce.description: Replay protection nonce as a string (for bigint compatibility)

chainId.description: The chain ID as a string (for bigint compatibility, max uint256)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp as a string (for bigint compatibility)

eip712Message.description: The EIP-712 typed data message structure
